blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **убе́жище** — asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter). Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ищ», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ищ).
**убежища** — убе́жище: asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter). Wiktionary: убежа́ть + -ище.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **сбо́рище** — assemblage, gathering of people. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ищ», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ищ).
**сборище** — сбо́рище: assemblage, gathering of people; mob. Wiktionary: сбор + -ище.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: He threw the cigarette butt on the ground.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **рубец** — scar, wake, cicatrice. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-ец», meaning 5 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ец).
**отде́лка** — finishing, trimming, decoration work/finish. Source: Wiktionary, «-ка» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ка#Russian).

exercises.q: I spent the holidays decorating the house.
exercises.why: **отделкой** — отде́лка: finishing, trimming, decoration work/finish; finish, decoration, trimmings. Wiktionary: отде́лать + -ка.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **Баранина** — бара́нина: mutton, lamb (the meat of sheep). Wiktionary: бара́н + -ина.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: оре́шник — (botany) hazel; убе́жище — asylum, refuge, sanctuary (a state of safety, protection or shelter); сбо́рище — assemblage, gathering of people; оку́рок — cigarette butt, cigar butt.
